data.subject: Public-records coverage for Petiole
data.body:
Hello,

Petiole USA Ltd's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in CBK, CBAN, and FRST.

On September 17, 2026, CBAN disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/711669/000110465926108432/cban-20260917x8k.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Best,
Andrew
